entries.title: Fixed Open Chalk Drawing Compass
entries.description: One original static large classroom drawing-compass appearance, laid flat in one fixed open pose. Two long tapered arms diverge from a common round hinge. A small finite blunt locating end is opposed by a genuine thick annular chalk sleeve holding a short protruding chalk cylinder, with one radial fixed clamp screw. A separate top turning grip and fixed hinge caps complete the whole tool. All geometry newly authored, no old scissors, sextant, magnetic compass or ruler mesh imported. One whole prop, not separately counted arms or chalk. Static visual art only: no actual hinge travel, adjustment, accurate circle construction, calibration, chalk marking, school-age suitability, sharpness, handling, manufacturing or safety claim.

entries.title: Complete Recessed Coffer Barrel Vault
entries.description: One newly authored complete static classical barrel-vault bay. A continuous thick semicylindrical roof has nine genuine blind soffit coffers: each recess has its own full ceiling and four closed thickness returns, while uninterrupted outer roof and crossing material ribs remain. Two complete long sidewall piers support the full lower springing strips. Both axial mouths and central aisle remain open. Three closed meshes, three constant opaque PBR materials, one reusable module and zero scenes. This is not a stretched old voussoir arch, a groin roof with one axis deleted, a low playground tunnel recolored or an oven with rear removed. All numerical geometry new; no reference vertices imported. Recesses do not pierce the roof and are not painted squares or detached repeated tiles. Geometry is a stylized game module only; no historical reconstruction, load bearing, engineering, acoustic, fire, human clearance, navigation, host compatibility or safety certification.

entries.title: Fixed Inclined-Carriage Leg Press
entries.description: One complete original static inclined-carriage leg press appearance: two full inclined guide rails rooted in a broad grounded chassis and upper columns, two genuine through-bored carriage sleeves linked by a crossmember, broad angled footplate and two empty weight pegs, fixed low seat with separate reclined back and small side grips. No weights, person or movement. All geometry newly authored, not a rotated old incline bench, a barbell rack with added seat or duplicated rowing rail. One model, zero scenes. Static visual only; no sliding, loading, resistance, body-fit, exercise instruction, manufacture, stability or safety performance claim.

entries.title: Static Curled-Abdomen Fan-Tail Prawn
entries.description: One newly authored stylised prawn-like whole animal exterior. A thin high forward rostrum continues into a deep narrow cephalothorax and a long shallowly segmented abdomen that curves down and forwards beneath its rear, ending in three broad tail-fan blades. Two small oblique stalk eyes, two long swept antennae, two shorter forward antennules and five pairs of thin complete thoracic legs belong to the same silhouette. All whole axial stations, rostrum, leg and antenna paths, fan outlines and eye placement are new, not a narrow crab, a scorpion with its hook removed, a seahorse laid flat or a leg-count recolour. Closed continuous body skin with intentional finite embedded roots for separate complete appendages; not a welded biological specimen. One prop, zero scenes or separately counted limbs. Metres, native Z up, front -Y and full horizontal bounds-centred lowest-foot display datum. Opaque matte untextured PBR, no water, food plate or background exported. Artistic static external form only: no exact species or life-size, scientific anatomy, complete gills or swimmerets, swimming, breathing, edible status, appendage articulation, rig, gait, animation, physical stability or ecological performance claim.
